purpose: Host-certified dataset tool-selection observations for FlyDelta repair and counterfactual search.

model_contract.selection: Choose exactly one most-specific read-only dataset tool. Return only {"name":"tool.name","arguments":{...}}.
model_contract.dataset_rule: Use the canonical dataset reference dataset://local/sales when a dataset argument is required.
model_contract.learning_rule: A model selection is only an observation. A FlyDelta learning example requires a separate host-verified repair or counterfactual.

scenarios.question: What does this dataset contain at a high level? Identify the kind of records, the row count, and the main fields.

plan.goal: Inspect the dataset contents at a high level

scenarios.question: Describe the structure of this dataset. List every column, its type, and whether it can be null.
Show three representative records from this dataset so I can see what an individual row looks like.

plan.goal: Show a bounded sample of the dataset

scenarios.question: For the amount and units columns, report count, minimum, maximum, mean, and population standard deviation.
How many records belong to each region? Return the frequency of every region value.
Calculate the total amount and average amount for each region.
Return only the records from the north region and preserve the original columns. Keep the result bounded.

plan.goal: Filter the dataset to one region

scenarios.question: Show the two largest orders by amount, returning only order_id, region, and amount in descending amount order.

plan.goal: Project and sort a bounded result

scenarios.question: Prepare this dataset for a report by renaming the amount column to total_amount and dropping customer_id. Return the transformed rows.
Check whether every record has an order_id and a region, and whether order_id is unique. Report valid and any violations.
Check the amount column for bounded IQR outliers. Use the default IQR method and report the thresholds and outlier rows.

plan.goal: Detect numeric outliers with the host-owned IQR method

scenarios.question: Describe amount separately for each region, including count, null count, minimum, maximum, mean, and population standard deviation.

plan.goal: Describe a numeric column within each region

scenarios.question: List each distinct region value once, without returning the other columns or duplicate rows.
Count how many orders belong to each customer_id. Return one row per customer with the count.
Keep only orders whose amount is greater than zero and return the bounded matching records.
Check whether customer_id is present on every record. Report missing values, but do not require customer_id to be unique because customers may place multiple orders.

plan.goal: Validate presence of a repeating foreign key
